oracle_cmd: (cwd: `pip download --no-deps raspberrypi-tm1637==1.3.8` unzipped to x/; its TM1637 _SEGMENTS gfedcba table) python3 -I -c 'import ast,re,sys; src=open("x/tm1637.py").read(); seg=ast.literal_eval(re.search(r"_SEGMENTS = bytearray\(\s*(b.*?)\)\n", src, re.S).group(1).replace("\n", " ")); inv={seg[i] for i in range(16)}; print([t for t in sys.argv[1].split() if int(t, 16) not in inv][:5])' "$encoded"  # -> tokens that are no TM1637 hex glyph: plain hex is not seven-segment
